stage_definition: zero-based rents 0-5: 5/6/7 spins; 6-9: 8/9 spins; 10-12: final 10-spin rents

feature_collision.note: Actual train encoder and analytic model context conflict audits found no conflicts. Synthetic mean-pooling timer-assignment loss is a structural risk, not demonstrated attribution. Current teacher does not read recent_income/effect_state.
feature_collision.model_context_method: Analytic signature of mean linear instance pooling, mean item embeddings, ordered board and all candidate pointers; train only. Different-label collisions may also reflect finite Monte Carlo teacher sensitivity to deck order.

candidate_ranking.probability_definition: Softmax of BC cross-entropy logits; uncalibrated categorical weights, not outcome probabilities

severity.limitation: Deepcopy shares exact starting RNG state and executes unchanged simulator. Different actions may consume different draws; common future events are not guaranteed. Exploratory branch outcomes, not strict causal effect.
severity.index_limitation: Only first occurrence per priority pair in seeds15000-15003. Frequency times observed positive stage delta is a prioritization index, not an unbiased population severity or causal estimate.

compounding.limitation: Observational windows include only multi-action decisions in next N total decisions; rent stage, selection and survival confound. No causal claim.

reroll.reason: RentForecastAgent.choose filters to PICK_SYMBOL/SKIP_SYMBOL; no reroll EV branch or score. Mask exposes REROLL correctly.

distribution_shift.method: phase and exact rent-stage conditioned maximum build similarity; candidate identities excluded; systematic equally sized controls
distribution_shift.limitation: Controls are descriptive, not randomized or matched for all game variables. No causal identification of error-to-shift chain.
